Centered permutation-rank covariance gives C=u L_Ka+v L_Kb, u=(a+1)t²/12, v=(b+1)s²/12. The two contrast eigenspaces yield au and bv; the 3x3 quotient has characteristic λ[λ²-(au+bv)λ+nuv]. Evaluating the quadratic at au,bv proves the two roots strictly straddle every internal contrast eigenvalue even at a=2 or b=2. With y=u/v>0 the exact identity κ+2+1/κ=4ab/n+(ay-b)²/(ny) makes y=b/a the unique minimizer, giving t/s=sqrt[b(b+1)/(a(a+1))] and exact optimal κ. Independent small-graph full orientation enumeration, exact rational covariance and characteristic polynomials passed; all-real proof is algebraic.
